# MASTERKRAFT

> MasterKraft designs, engineers and supplies commercial and home gym equipment and delivers complete custom gym fitouts across Australia and the Asia-Pacific. Made by fitness professionals, for fitness professionals.

MasterKraft designs, supplies and installs complete gym floors across strength, weightlifting, cardio and functional training, and supplies franchise networks against one approved equipment spec, club by club. Equipment can carry a gym's own logo and colours. Service is backed by a 72-hour service SLA, in writing.

## Fitouts

- [Gym fitouts](https://masterkraft.com/fitout): all fitout types, and the cities we deliver in
- [Commercial gym fitouts](https://masterkraft.com/fitout/commercial-gym-fitout): complete commercial gym solutions, from a single zone to a full multi-level facility
- [Independent gym fitouts](https://masterkraft.com/fitout/independent-gym-fitout): commercial-grade equipment for independently owned gyms, branded as theirs
- [Franchise gym fitouts](https://masterkraft.com/fitout/franchise-gym-fitout): one spec in the network's colours, rolled out club by club
- [Boutique fitness fitouts](https://masterkraft.com/fitout/boutique-fitness-fitout)
- [Elite sports club fitouts](https://masterkraft.com/fitout/elite-sports-clubs-fitout)
- [PT studio fitouts](https://masterkraft.com/fitout/pt-studio-fitout)
